claims.text: Give as needed for partial- or full-thickness burns.
claims.quote: If necessary, a tetanus shot should be given to patients with partial-thickness or full-thickness burns.

claims.text: A toxoid booster if fully vaccinated with no booster in the past 5 years;
claims.quote: A tetanus toxoid booster (subcutaneously or IM) is given to patients with all but minor burns who have been previously fully vaccinated and who have not received a booster within the past 5 years.

claims.text: tetanus immune globulin (human) 250 units IM, with the toxoid,
claims.quote: tetanus immune globulin (human) 250 units IM and concomitant active vaccination

claims.text: ONLY if the primary series is incomplete or unknown (also with HIV or severe immunodeficiency, regardless of history) (CDC; a remote booster just needs the toxoid)
